page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6a.4xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average multi-core capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core scores falling into the middle 50% tier. However, single-core performance is limited, as evidenced by a stress-ng single-core CPU result in the bottom 10%. Memory performance shows a stark contrast: cached small-block read bandwidth is average at 742.7 GB/sec, whereas uncached large-block read and write bandwidths are weak, placing in the bottom 25% at 29.99 GB/sec and 15.38 GB/sec respectively.

Given its high memory density and moderate multi-threaded processing capabilities, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring large memory footprints without demanding extreme single-core compute performance. It is well-suited for memory-intensive applications such as in-memory databases like Redis, caching layers, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from 128 GB of RAM but do not require local NVMe storage.
